scripts.check: vp run check:ts && vp run check:py
scripts.check:fix: vp run check:ts --fix && vp run check:py:fix
scripts.check:py: uv run ruff format --check . && uv run ruff check . && uv run ty check
scripts.check:py:fix: uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format . && uv run ty check
scripts.test: vp run test:ts && vp run test:py
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/server && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.app:build: cd apps/server && docker compose --profile app build
scripts.app:up: cd apps/server && docker compose --profile app up --detach --wait
scripts.app:down: cd apps/server && docker compose --profile app rm --stop --force api worker agent parse web
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta,green" --names api,worker,web "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:worker" "pnpm --filter @public-atlas/web run dev"
scripts.dev:api: cd apps/server && uv run fastapi dev
scripts.dev:worker: cd apps/server && uv run watchfiles --target-type command public-atlas-worker src
scripts.browser:install: cd apps/server && uv run playwright install chromium
scripts.ci: vp run check && vp run check:generated && vp run test && vp run -r build
